name: Lesson propose (one fix per repeat BLOCK cause)

knobs.note: BH-5807: 0 stops the lane before any request. Read by bin/lesson-propose.sh as ${LESSON_PROPOSE_ENABLED:-1}; any value other than 0 or 1 is one warn line in logs/lesson-propose.log and the default.

BH-5807: triggers one tick may work on (a model call, a stored-draft delivery or a harness bug), and new category rows one tick may add. Read by bin/lesson-propose.sh as ${LESSON_PROPOSE_MAX_PER_TICK:-3}; outside 1..20 is one warn line and the default.
BH-5807: seconds one drafting call may run (bin/agent-call.sh timeout). Read by bin/lesson-propose.sh as ${LESSON_PROPOSE_TIMEOUT_S:-300}; outside 60..1200 is one warn line and the default.

0 makes this lane call no model at all. bin/lib/llm-gate.sh refuses BEFORE the vendor call and writes a zero-cost row_source=refused row, so the stop is visible in the ledger rather than being a lane that went quiet.
Comma/space list of the ONLY ladder rungs this lane may reach. Empty is every rung, i.e. today's ladder unchanged. A rung outside the list is refused before the call.
Dollars this lane may spend in the current UTC day, summed from D1 cost_rows through GET /api/metrics/llm-spend, never from the box's own logs/cost.csv.
